name: Frontier Model Technical Report & System Card Batch Pack
description: Declarative 4-stage batch pipeline for extracting benchmark evaluation logs, compiling calm-authority technical reports, executing adversarial audits, and syncing to Google Drive and NotebookLM fleets.

pipeline.task_action: Parse raw benchmark outputs across Terminal-Bench, OSWorld, and SWE-bench into structured JSON tables.
Draft Tier L4 model release report and Tier L5 system card sections adhering strictly to writing-like-claude 10 Invariants.
Run audit_calm_writing.py to verify elimination of banned hype adjectives and confirm presence of pinned benchmark baselines.
Execute scripts/sync_drive.py --push to ingest living markdown dossiers into Google Drive and NotebookLM research fleets.
